notes.takeover_limits: Undo is told by value: a sequence value this session removed. An inverse carried across a reopen reports (pinned), past MAX_REMOVED_SEQUENCES (128) the oldest removal is forgotten: a report, never a refusal. Hand-inserting the identical value reports nothing. A new TRACK or CLIP taking an inert member through a direct commit is not reported. Harness-core and the Viewer do not surface routing_takeovers yet, outside this lane's paths: the host sees no message. The session frame carries no field for it: Observation has outcome only.
